text: Clone an app's frontend and backend into a new local project with its own app ID
quote: This command downloads the frontend code and backend resources from a selected app and creates a new project with its own app ID.

text: Connect an app to GitHub to develop locally or in Base44 and keep both in sync
quote: Connect your app to GitHub to write code in your local development environment or in Base44 and keep them in sync with each other.

text: Connect your own AI coding agent or scripts to an app's sandbox environment
quote: Bring your own AI coding agent, or your own scripts, to a Base44 app by connecting to its sandbox.

text: Use an SDK to build custom frontend or backend apps that use Base44 as a backend service
quote: Use the SDK to build your own frontend or backend that uses Base44 as a backend service.

text: CLI tool to create, sync, and deploy Base44 apps from the terminal
quote: The Base44 CLI is a command-line tool for building and managing Base44 apps from your terminal. Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources

text: AI agents inside the app can perform actions like updating records and triggering workflows, not just chat
quote: AI agents turn simple chats into actions in your Base44 app. Instead of only replying with text, they update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools

text: Published apps expose an MCP server so external AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can connect
quote: App MCP lets external AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor connect to your published app through its own Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

text: Automatic SSL certificate issuance and renewal once a custom domain is connected
quote: Base44 issues and renews your SSL certificate automatically once your domain is connected, so your app is always served securely over HTTPS.

text: Data page displays every table as a card you can open to view records
quote: The Data page shows every table in your app as a card. Click a card to open its records.

text: Publish your own app templates publicly for others to use
quote: You can also publish your own public templates for others to use, reaching a wider audience while showcasing your skills.

text: Offer multiple sign-up methods like email and Google for login
quote: You can offer multiple ways for people to sign up, such as email, Google, or other providers, so that login stays simple, secure, and familiar.

text: Visual board to see all app pages at once, leave notes, sketch ideas, and send instructions to AI
quote: See every page at once. Leave notes, sketch ideas, and send instructions straight to AI — all on one board.

text: Set global colors and fonts for the entire app from a single place
quote: Set colors and fonts for your entire app from one place. Your entire app — updated everywhere at once.

text: Ask AI for design options and preview them before applying changes
quote: Ask for design options, pick the one you want. AI shows previews before it touches anything.

text: Start from an existing website and refine it in the app editor
quote: Begin from a website you already own and refine it in the app editor.

text: Turn a Figma frame into a working app
quote: Turn a Figma frame into a working app.

text: Build full-stack apps using the SDK, CLI, and a managed backend
quote: Build full-stack apps with the SDK, CLI, and a managed backend.

text: Connect app to GitHub for version control, local development, and collaboration
quote: Connect your Base44 app to GitHub for version control, local development, and collaboration.

text: Create new backend projects with the CLI, optionally starting from templates
quote: Create new Base44 backend projects with the create command. You can choose from available templates to get started quickly.

text: Browse a wide range of community-made ready-made templates
quote: Browse a wide range of ready-made templates created by talented creators in the community.

text: Generate a video from a text description and add it to app pages
quote: Describe a video, get one. Add it to any page — hero sections, onboarding screens, product previews.

text: CRUD operations on app data entities via the SDK
quote: entities: Work with your app's data entities using CRUD operations.

text: Backend defined entirely in code and configuration files so AI coding agents can build and manage the project
quote: Your entire backend is defined in code and configuration files, making it easy for AI coding agents to build and manage your project.

text: Custom domain support to give published apps a professional branded URL
quote: A custom domain looks more professional and reinforces your brand every time someone visits.

text: Built-in customizable login, register, forgot-password, and reset-password pages for every new app
quote: All new Base44 apps come with custom login pages built in. You get ready-made login, register, forgot password, and reset password pages that you can customize

text: Built-in pages live inside the app and can be customized, translated, and rebranded
quote: They live inside your app, so you can customize the design, translate them into any language, and add your own branding.

text: Install and use the CLI to log in and create a project from npm
quote: npm install -g base44@latest # Install the CLI base44 login # Authenticate base44 create # Create a project
